LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public high-score entry for a verified player in Floaki Winter Surfer (no PII stored).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player owning this leaderboard entry.

playerName.description: Public display nickname shown on the leaderboard.

distance.description: Distance in meters of the best run.

crystals.description: Crystals collected during the best run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player first joined the leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last high-score or nickname update.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Stores each player's personal best leaderboard record, keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.
